resources.string: Written messages and learning requests are sent to Google Gemini and billed to your Google AI project, which may include a free tier. The key stays encrypted on this phone and is sent only to Google. Voice conversations still use your OpenAI key.
No Mural minute limit. Your Google AI project covers Gemini usage. Voice conversations still use your OpenAI key.
To use Gemini for written conversations, choose My API key under Conversation access. Mural minutes keep using Mural\'s AI. Voice conversations still need your OpenAI key.
Written messages and learning requests are sent to Google Gemini. Google data handling terms apply. Voice conversations still need your OpenAI key.

Written messages and learning requests will be sent to Google Gemini and billed to your Google AI project. Google data handling terms apply. Voice still requires an OpenAI key. Mural minutes remain available if you switch back.
